chapter.verse: Sanggamte aw, Macedonia gam pawlpite laka kipia Pasian' hehpihna thu kong theisak nuam uh hi.
A hang pen sittelna suksiapi khat ahi gimna hun laitak, amaute' lungdamna a tampi leh amaute' zawnna a lianpi panin citna a dimletin phulkhia khin hi.
Amau' hihzawh zah bek hilo-in amau' uttawm thu tawh hihzawhzah khengval a piak uh ka theihpih hi.
Mi siangthote donna vakna pankhop ding vai ah amaute kihel nuamin tua hamphatna kote' tungah kinna tak tawh hong kun uh hi.
Hih pen kote' lamet zah ciang bek hilo a, Pasian' deihna bangin a masa-in Topa' tungah, tua ciangin kote' tungah amaumah hong kipia uh ahi hi.
Tua tawh kizui-in Titus zong note' lakah hih citpiak nasepna a patsa ahih mah bangin hong zawhsiangpih nadingin amah ka hanthawn uh hi.
Tu-in upna, thugenna, thutheihna, thulela kinna, note' sunga om kong itna uh, cihte-a kipan na khempeuh ah gina thahat na hih mah bangun hih citpiak nasepna ah zong a gina a thahat na hita un.
Hih pen thupiak bang hilo-in midangte' kinna lungsim enkakin nomau' itna zong a tak a maan ahihlam lahtel nadinga kong gen ahi hi.
A hang pen i Topa Jesu Khris' hong hehpihna thu na theih uh hi a, amah a hau hinapi ama' zawnna tawh note na hauh theih nadingun note hong khualna-in amah mizawng hong suak hi.
Hih tawh kisai-in keima' ngaihsut kong genin ah: nikumin nasep na kipat uh bek hilo-in sem ding cih utna lungsim neih na kipat uh pen note' hamphatna ahi hi.
Tua ahih manin tu-in zong utna lungsim tawh na sepnop uh thu na tangtut nadingun na neihsa uh zangin na maban uh na zosiang un.
A hang pen utna lungsim tawh ahih nakleh neih loh tungtawn hilo-in neih bangbang a santaak ahi hi.
Tua pen no teng vangik pua-in midangte peng ding ka cihna hilo a, thulekkim thu a gen ka hizaw hi.
Tu laitaka note' cihtheihna tawh amau' kitangsapna na sik uhleh amau zong amau' cihtheihna tawh note' kitangsapna hong sik ding ahih manin thulekkim thu hong hiding hi.
“Tampi a ngahte in khamval nei lo uh a, tawmno a ngahte in kitangsap nei lo uh hi,” ci-in a kigelh bang ahi hi.
Ahi zongin note' tunga kong neih kinna nam Titus' lungsim sungah hong koihsak Pasian' tungah i lungdam hi.
A hang pen komau' kutna hong sang bek thamlo, amahmah kinin ama' uttawm thu tawh note' kiangah hong pai ding ahi hi.
Lungdamna Thu tangkona hangin pawlpite khempeuh' pahtak sanggampa zong amah tawh kong sawlkhawm uh hi.
Tua bek hilo, hih sanggampa pen Topa mahmah a minphat nading leh komau' deihsakna lahkhiat nadingin hih citpiak nasep vai ka vanna uhah kote tawh a zinkhawm dingin pawlpite' teel zong ahi hi.
Hih ka van uh citpiak nasepna hangin kuamah in hong mawhsak loh nadingin tu-a bangin a kigingkhol ka hi uh hi.
A hang pen kote in Topa' mai bek ah hilo-in mite' mai-ah zong a kilawm ahih ding ngaihsutin ka nei uh hi.

I sanggam dang khat zong amaute gel tawh kong tonsak uh hi. Amah pen thu tampi ah ka sittel zelzel uh a, kinna lungsim nei ahihlam ka theih ban uhah tu-in note nakpi hong muanna hangin a ngei sangin kinzaw tham lai hi.
Titus tawh kisai-in ahihleh amah pen note' adingin ka kithuahpih leh ka naseppih hi a, sanggampihte tawh kisai-in ahihleh amau pen pawlpite' sawl palaite, Khris ii minpha a kilangsakte ahi uh hi.
Tua hi a, note' itna thu leh hih mite' kianga nomau' thu ka kisialh teng uh a maan ahihlam pawlpite' mai-ah lahcianna na pia ta un.
